name: event_entity_sentiment_benchmark_final
description: A dataset for entity-level sentiment classification within event contexts: given text describing events and mentioned entities, the benchmark measures whether models correctly predict sentiment or stance toward those entities. It evaluates fine-grained sentiment understanding tied to event semantics and entity roles across examples. Labels and splits are provided for supervised evaluation.
evaluation_method: F1 (often micro- and/or macro-F1); accuracy is also used
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset by OLAResearch used for research in event-aware sentiment analysis; modest community visibility.
